title: SHARDOR Coffee Grinder Electric, Spice Grinder Electric, Herb Grinder, Grinder for Coffee Bean Spices and Seeds with 2 Removable Stainless Steel Bowls, Black
description:
About this item
✔️【Super Convenient Coffe Grinder】Just by simply pressing the lid for different seconds to get coarse or fine coffee powder. Get desired powder in 15 seconds or less.The stainless steel cups can be removed from the base. The removable cups are dishwasher safe and easy to clean as well.

reviews_5s:
As a passionate home chef , I've experimented with numerous kitchen gadgets, but the SHARDOR Coffee Grinder has truly transformed my culinary experience. From the moment I unboxed this beautifully designed appliance, I was struck by its blend of modern aesthetics and practical functionality. It feels like a thoughtful addition to any kitchen countertop.

The standout feature, of course, is the **dual stainless steel bowls**. These bowls allow for incredible versatility—whether I’m grinding fresh basil for pesto or creating vibrant wet mixes for sauces, the SHARDOR grinder handles it all with remarkable ease. The **grinding mechanism** is intuitive; with a simple press of the lid, I can achieve my desired consistency in seconds. Preparing fresh pesto has never been easier or more enjoyable!

What I particularly love is the **ease of acquiring extra lids and bowls**. This means I can prep multiple ingredients simultaneously without missing a beat. Having additional bowls on hand truly elevates my kitchen prep, allowing for a seamless workflow during busy cooking sessions.

While I typically don’t use grinders for coffee, I’m excited to designate a second unit for my weekend getaway. Having fresh coffee at my disposal while I unwind is a delightful luxury I can now enjoy. It’s perfect for those leisurely mornings where I can savor a freshly brewed cup while soaking in the ambiance.

Cleanup is a breeze thanks to the **dishwasher-safe bowls**—a feature that every busy home cook will appreciate. This thoughtful touch eliminates the hassle of hand washing, allowing me to focus on what I love most: creating delicious meals.

In a market flooded with kitchen gadgets, the SHARDOR Coffee Grinder stands out as a quintessential tool for anyone serious about their culinary endeavors. It combines style, performance, and versatility into one fantastic package. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking to elevate their cooking game!Great spice grinder! Love the removable cups and it makes for easy cleaning. I only use it for spices but I've also used it for reheated smoked peppers like guajillo chilis, and it chewed through those peppers really well. Hold your breath when you open it :)

Way better than my old grinder because of the ease of cleaning. One challenge is I did drop the cap once and it cracked, and one of the pins to trigger the grinder broke off but fortunately there are two and with some tape it's still working just fine.

I did get a heat-protection shut off once when running it for too long trying to blitz tortilla chips into a powder (ATK chili recipe....iykyk) but after it cooled off it worked again with no problems and I haven't had that issue since.I highly recommend it to everyone. This grinder works really fast. I ❤️ it👍☺️Simple and easy to use. Made of durable material.The BEST Birthday Gift I gave to myself. I am so happy with this product. It’s durable, sturdy, EASY TO CLEAN .. Yayeeeeee .. VERY compact, easy and comfortable to use. Saves me tons of time in the kitchen. Easy to store. Great for grinding coffee, spices according to the level of coarseness or fine grinding you need for different recipes. Comes with two different cups. One has two blades and the other has four blades. I made AMAZING Guacamole, Hummus, Chuntneys & Mezze with this. Perfect for a family of two. Absolutely high quality product for the price. The design will match any interiors or kitchen.I purchased the Shardor CG628B Spice Grinder Electric with 2 bowls in June of 2021. It is now February of 2025. It is one of my most often used kitchen tools and I have been mincing garlic, grinding spices and creating fwet and dry rubs with it for 4 years now. It is easy to use and store when not in use. It is also easy to clean. The stainless-steel bowls are heavy gauge and have managed the dishwasher over the four years.
The spindle on the grinder stem sheared last week when a garlic clove that was partially frozen became lodged under one of the blades. I believe that this was an unlikely occurrence because I had been doing this for 4 years without a problem. I am giving this product a 5-star review not only because of its endurance but also because when I reached out to Shardor Customer Service explaining what had happened, they immediately offered to replace the machine for free. This was above and beyond their obligation to do.
I highly recommend not only this grinder but Shardor as a company for its interest in having satisfied customers.I love that this coffee grinder comes with 2 removable stainless steel grinding reservoirs. I’ve used it for coffee, spices, and nuts. It’s a good deal, easy to use, and works great, years later. You can shorten the cord underneath the device if needed. I put the reservoirs in the dishwasher once in a while. When I accidentally broke the lid by dropping it on the floor, the manufacturer replied right away to my request for a replacement lid.tried with some dry spices, did an amazing job. it's a decent grinder in this size.Wonderful grinder, reasonably priced and easy to use. I use it mainly to grind flax & chia seeds and it quickly does the job. There are two removable grinder cups that are very convenient which makes cleanup very easy. Please make certain when you place the cup into the unit, you twist it down slightly. If you don’t, it wont run. The last thing I want to mention is the customer service… I sent them an email for a problem I was having but it turned out I didn’t do as I mentioned above. I forgot to twist the cup into place…before I figured out my problem I reached out to their customer service by email and they quickly got back with me. I highly recommend purchasing from this company.Super easy to clean
reviews_1s:
Click to play video
I would have returned it but missed the window. That said, it works great and ground my bay leaves into powder in a pretty short time. Another update @ 11 months...

Update 3.5 months later...not because of Shardor, but because of my slowness (they have great customer service...read on...) I wrote the above 3 star review based on the noise, more than a month after receiving the unit, even though it worked well. It was difficult to rate a product that worked well but was noisy. Anyway, they contacted me quickly and offered a replacement. I probably took another month getting back to them (a couple of deaths in the family had me doing everything slower than normal). They replied quickly but needed more information and it probably took me another month to respond. When I finally responded with the information, they promptly sent a replacement. I got it a few weeks ago and finally got a chance to try it out and it is sooooooo quiet and works great! I can't believe that they were so kind that after all of my delays, they still made the situation right. I will buy Shardor again anytime. 5 stars.

Update @11 months: It's been a long time, I know, but I only use the grinder every couple of months to grind herbs and spices. But a month ago grinding my peppercorns for cooking, I noticed that some of the peppercorns were not getting touched at all, they were still full round peppercorns. I noticed this the first time I used it, but I think I was so excited to get the quiet replacement that I thought I must have done something wrong. But this time, I took a closer look and noticed that there was no uniformity in the peppercorns, from powder to whole, even after grinding for a minute or so. So, I examined the cup to see what the problem was, and it seemed to me that there were no bearings, the blade just flops around in the base housing. Nothing is visibly broken and the blade spins, but moves up and down and from side to side quite a bit. Since the customer service was so great, I contacted them again, and long story short, I sent them videos of the loose blade and they told me that's the way it's supposed to be, the blades flopping around. I don't know why they think that it's okay for one of the cups to have a floppy blade because the other cup doesn't have the same issue, the blade is securely attached to the cup. Go figure. I don't like to give them only one star because the first time their CS is very responsive, but this review is on the product. I'm going to have to spend more money on another brand. :-(What is with the sound of grinding marbles?
I trued it first, without anything. It sounds as if it’s grinding marbles, or rather the metal blades are draping the inside metal cup?
Are the blades bent?
Do they bend and dip as the whirl?
Is in inside the unit that is off?

Certainly not good for the longevity of the unit nor is it a welcome sound in the morning. Ahh, fingernails on the chalkboard.

Sadly, this is going back and I’m cancelling my orders as gifts as well.

So sad.I purchased this grinder with high expectations, primarily using the spice grinder attachment. It performed well until, one morning, it suddenly stopped working. Nothing appears broken or missing, but the machine won’t start. The lid no longer engages the mechanism as it used to.

Upon troubleshooting, I discovered that pressing the two thin black nuts on the main body manually activates the machine, but it won’t run with the lid on, making it unusable. Unfortunately, the return window has long expired, and despite meticulous care, I didn't expect such an issue. I feel disappointed and hope to contact the seller for troubleshooting or a replacement before considering another purchase.This is a HORRIBLE ITEM WITH HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SUPPORT. The grinder was purchased as a gift. When the recipient started using the grinder it started to overheat The usage is with normal coffee beans. Now they will not help me with an exchange and it appears that amazon will not help me either. I was told by the company to contact amazon for help!!!!! Very frustratedMy grinder burnt out as I was making a Garlic, Pepper, Salt rub for steaks. I had hoped it would be a good grinder for long term use since I paid a higher price, but it burnt out the third time I used it. Going to continue to look for good grinder. This one didn't cut it.I bought this primarily to grind spices and other aromatics like herbs, garlic, and ginger etc. It replaced an old, very basic coffee grinder that didn't have a detachable basket and was hard to clean. It's perplexing how even though this is supposed to be easy to clean, it's somehow more messy to use than my old one. The chamber where the basket sits often gets dirty from things leaking and I end up doing even more cleaning than I did with the old one. Most importantly, this doesn't grind any of the whole spices fine enough or evenly throughout so I'm still left with small chunks unless I shake the entire appliance like a cocktail shaker for a very long time. The motor isn't great either so it'll start to heat up and smell weird when it's been going for longer than a minute. The motor engages the blade when you press down on the lid, and the lid unfortunately doesn't sit airtight unless you hold it down the whole time. Kind of hard to do while you're trying to shake it to ensure everything gets ground evenly. Trying to puree anything is such a chore, because you'll have random lumps that won't get cut by the blade unless you shake or mix manually. Overall very frustrating to use.This product worked twice and now won’t even start. Do not buy, waste of money!I bought it in Nov 2024 and it suddenly stopped working in April 2025. Absolutely bad product . I was not able to even get support.I've had it for a couple of months, used it maybe 10 times. Now I'm looking for a new one, because this one stopped working.After six months of limited use, this grinder has ceased functioning. The blade is stuck, and a distinct smell of smoke is emitting from the device. Do yourself and the planet a favor and stay away!
